title: Man Intentionally Crashes into Police Department Over Son’s Citation
description:
On November 16, 2021, an officer was on duty inside the Police Department office when a vehicle struck the building in Cumberland, WI. The man stated he was upset because his son had been given a citation by a Cumberland Police Officer. He felt like everyone was targeting his son and wanted someone to talk to about it. Therefore, he believed the best way to get ahold of someone was by intentionally ramming into the building. 

For business inquiries or other questions contact:
codebluecam@gmail.com

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
